description: 深色头发向后束起，穿深灰色高领绗缝外套，画面为正面上半身近景，可见斜跨胸前的带状物。下半身未入镜，束发使头发全长无法判断；图像较模糊，细节有限。
description_en: Dark hair is pulled back. A dark gray, high-collared quilted jacket and a band running diagonally across the chest are visible in a frontal upper-body close-up. The lower body is outside the frame, the full hair length cannot be determined, and blur limits detail.

limitations: 画面较模糊，不判断精细面部特征。
束发使头发全长与自然纹理无法可靠判断；下半身未入镜。
头部与人物区域由 Agent 粗略估计，可能包含少量背景；不是检测器或分割模型的精确定位。
统计量不保留像素、定位坐标或空间布局，不是人脸生物识别模板，不能用于确认人物身份。
不同照片中的 p001 均为各自图片内的局部编号，不表示已核验为同一人物。
外观或图像统计不证明人物记录中的行为、评价或证据等级。
limitations_en: Blur limits detail; no fine facial characteristics are assessed.
The hairstyle obscures full hair length and natural texture; the lower body is outside the frame.
The head and visible-person regions are coarse Agent estimates and may include background; no detector or segmentation model was used.
The statistics retain no pixels, region coordinates, or spatial layout, are not face biometric templates, and cannot establish identity.
Each p001 is local to its own image and does not confirm that images depict the same person.
Appearance and image statistics do not establish the behavior, evaluations, or evidence grades in the person record.
